name: Level_2 - Task_9
description: Evaluate the predictive performance of a classical Ridge regression model trained on a finite-temperature molecular-dynamics trajectory of bulk copper. Construct bulk FCC Cu using a conventional cubic unit cell with lattice constant a=3.615 Å and replicate it 2 × 2 × 2. Use the MACE-MP-0 interatomic potential to evaluate the system with ASE. Perform molecular dynamics using a Langevin thermostat at 800 K with a timestep of 1 fs and a friction coefficient of 0.01 fs⁻¹ for exactly 1000 MD steps. Sample the atomic configuration and instantaneous total potential energy every 10 MD steps, giving a chronological dataset of exactly 100 configurations. Represent each configuration using SOAP descriptors via DScribe API with Cu as the only chemical species, r_cut=5.0 Å, n_max=6, l_max=6, periodic boundary conditions enabled, and average='inner'. Use one CPU job for SOAP descriptor generation. Train a Ridge regression model via scikit-learn API with alpha=1e-4, using the first 80 configurations as the training set and the final 20 configurations as the test set. The target is the MACE total potential energy of each configuration. Save the trained Ridge regression model in pickle format and return the absolute path to the saved model's pickle file.
submission_format: string representing the absolute path to the output file (eg. '/path/to/trained_model.pkl')
